item.title: Albuquerque City Council rejects plan to restrict short-term housing
item.description: ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (KRQE) – Albuquerque City Council once again shot down restrictions on short-term rentals, such as Airbnbs. The bill, which would have banned new permits near another short-term rental, failed Monday night by a 5-4 vote.
